discovery: GET https://electionresults.iowa.gov/IA/elections.json and take EID from the entry whose Date matches; then GET /IA/<EID>/current_ver.txt for the version. https://electionresults.iowa.gov/ redirects (301) to /IA/, the 'List Elections' page that reads that file.
bot_blocking: Relay User-Agent: 200 on everything (Amazon CloudFront). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried with curl. Headless Chrome (playwright, whose User-Agent says HeadlessChrome) got CloudFront's '403 ERROR The request could not be satisfied. Request blocked.' on /IA/, so there is a WAF rule against headless browsers but not against a plain named client.
updated_field: electionsettings.json settings.websiteupdatedat = '11/4/2026 12:25:40 PM CST' (US Central, the zone abbreviation is in the string). The HTTP Last-Modified of summary.json agrees: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 18:25:20 GMT. The count had not been republished between then and 2026-11-10.
reporting_field: Per contest in summary.json: PR (reporting) and TP (total). In Iowa the units are counties, not precincts: United States Senator TP 99, PR 95; United States Representative District 1 TP 20, PR 18; State Senator District 1 TP 1, PR 1.

measures: City of Bellevue - Public Measure LI

choice_format: Parallel arrays per contest: CH names, P parties, V votes. Example (United States Senator): "CH":["Ashley Hinson","Josh Turek","Thomas Laehn","Write-in"], "P":["REP","DEM","LIB",""], "V":[630615,686486,42052,1686]. Parties seen: REP, DEM, LIB and '' (write-in, no-party and nonpartisan). The governor ticket is one choice: 'Rob Sand and Dave Muhlbauer'. Measures: "CH":["Yes","No"] with empty parties. Judicial retentions are one contest per judge ('Court of Appeals Judge - John M. Sandy').
district_field: Only in the title ('State Senator District 1'). Contests also carry CAT / SUBCAT groupings ('Federal' / 'United States Representative'; 'State' / 'State Senate District 1 - 25', 'State Representative District 26 - 50', 'Statewide Executive Branch', 'Constitutional Amendment'); SUBCAT is missing (key absent) on City and School contests. K is a numeric contest key (US Senator 1000, US Rep District 1 1100, Governor 1500, State Senator District 1 2100, Constitutional Amendment 1 14600).
